title: Subagent session links open transcripts without file navigation

source.name: 09 subagents: a subagent link opens its transcript without a file navigator

steps.text: The researcher found the project name.

invariant: A session anchor reaches the subagent handler, never file reading. Desktop opens the child panel with no navigator; phone opens the child session. Returning preserves the parent transcript.
